rationale: A is clearer and consistently normalizes every output domino to a tuple, whereas B may return a heterogeneous chain when the input contains lists because its first domino is preserved verbatim while later dominoes are tuples. A also avoids redundantly exploring the same orientation twice for doubles; although its repeated slicing is less efficient than B's index-based tracking, its simpler state management and more uniform output make it the better-quality implementation.
